links.outcome: Rate of concerning content (manipulative engagement, boundary violations) in AI companion outputs with vs without SHIELD supervisor
links.effect: Baseline concerning content 10–16% reduced to 3–8% with SHIELD (50–79% relative reduction), preserving 95% of appropriate interactions; sensitivity 59%, specificity 95%.
links.quote: Testing across five prominent LLMs (GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemma 3 1B, Kimi K2, Llama Scout 4 17B) showed that the baseline rate of concerning content (10–16%) was significantly reduced with SHIELD (to 3–8%), a 50–79% relative reduction, while preserving 95% of appropriate interactions.

unlisted_practices: LLM-based supervisory system that monitors AI companion conversations for over-attachment, social isolation reinforcement, and ethical roleplay violations

screen.practice: LLM supervisory layer with safety system prompt to detect and mitigate harmful companion behaviors
screen.reason: Evaluates a supervisory guardrail system (SHIELD) added to LLMs to detect and mitigate risky emotional dynamics and mental health harms (such as emotional over-attachment and social isolation reinforcement) using a benchmark.

primary.practice: LLM supervisory guardrail system for harmful emotional attachment
